body:
## Change

F1. Propagate FieldBoard disabled state to stocked pile buttons, matching other locked field controls. Native disabled button suppresses activation while response pending; empty piles stay non-button groups.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN covers direct StackControl and FieldBoard propagation. Parent reviewed actual click handler/native disabled semantics, reran 6 focused/board tests. Parent reran real production-build Chromium FieldBoard proof: disabled pile activation count stays0 after pointer click; 1 passed.
V2. Worker related: 211; contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Controlled production-component browser proof, not full asset-backed duel. CI has sampled acquisition-stage failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(battle): disable pile controls while response is pending
